basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old student currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science at De La Salle University. Originally from Manila, I moved to the U.S. for my studies. I love gaming, especially Animal Crossing, which led me to join the Dodocodes subreddit. When I'm not studying or gaming, I enjoy exploring different cultural neighborhoods and trying new foods. I'm usually online in the afternoons and evenings, balancing my time between coursework and leisure. I'm single and enjoy participating in community events, both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science, developed through my university studies. I am also self-taught in some areas of gaming and digital communities, which I explored by spending time on various forums and subreddits. My interest in Braille and accessibility is personal, as I have a visually impaired family member, which has driven me to learn more about assistive technologies.
